content.text: All language semantics and structural checks pass. Now the lifecycle/replay tests:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_lifecycle.py <<'EOF'
"""Replay lifecycle: versions, identity, handoffs, capacity, atomicity."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

DENY = 4294967295
OK = {"ok": True}
REJ = {"error": "rejected"}
INV = {"error": "invalid"}
SVC = [{"name": "A", "label": 10}, {"name": "B", "label": 4}, {"name": "C", "label": 7}]
LIM = {"images": 16, "cells": 262144, "units": 1024, "contexts": 32768,
       "connections": 4096, "packets": 32768, "files": 8192}

def evs(events, services=SVC, limits=None):
    r = run_cli(req([job(services, events, limits)]))
    return r["results"][0]["events"]

def expect(name, events, wants, services=SVC, limits=None):
    check(name, evs(events, services, limits), wants)

# ---------- stage / commit / retire ----------
expect("stage epoch high-water", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 5, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 5, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 4, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 6, "policy": ""},
], [{"ok": True, "epoch": 5, "image": {"accept": [True], "rows": [[0, 0, 0]]}}, REJ, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 6, "image": {"accept": [False], "rows": [[DENY, DENY, DENY]]}}])

expect("commit and retire", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},          # active -> rejected
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 2, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 2},
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},          # ok now
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},          # gone
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},          # gone
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 2},          # reactivation ok
], [OK, OK, REJ, OK, OK, OK, REJ, REJ, OK])

expect("retire needs zero refs", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},          # context ref
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},          # ok
], [OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, REJ, {"ok": True, "allow": True}, OK])

# ---------- spawn / clone / exit ----------
expect("spawn identity rules", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},   # occupied
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 2], "service": "A"},   # occupied pair
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "Z"},   # unregistered
    {"op": "exit", "unit": [0, 1, 1]},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "B"},   # gen <= hw
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 2], "service": "B"},   # ok
    {"op": "exit", "unit": [0, 1, 3]},                    # wrong gen
    {"op": "exit", "unit": [0, 1, 2]},
], [OK, REJ, REJ, REJ, OK, REJ, OK, REJ, OK])

expect("clone inherits and copies", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [7, 3, 1], "service": "C"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [7, 3, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [7, 3, 1], "rid": 2},
    {"op": "clone", "parent": [7, 3, 1], "child": [7, 4, 1]},
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [7, 4, 1], "rid": 1},        # child's copy
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [7, 3, 1], "rid": 1},        # parent's original
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [7, 4, 1], "rid": 1},        # gone
    {"op": "clone", "parent": [7, 3, 2], "child": [7, 5, 1]},  # parent wrong gen
    {"op": "clone", "parent": [7, 3, 1], "child": [7, 4, 1]},  # child occupied
], [OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0},
    OK, {"ok": True, "allow": True}, {"ok": True, "allow": True}, REJ, REJ, REJ])

# clone capacity atomicity
lim = dict(LIM); lim["contexts"] = 3
expect("clone capacity atomic", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},
    {"op": "clone", "parent": [0, 1, 1], "child": [0, 2, 1]},  # 2+2 > 3 -> reject
    {"op": "inspect"},
], [OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "active": None, "images": [[1, 1, 3, 2]], "units": 1, "contexts": 2,
     "connections": 0, "packets": 0, "files": 0}], limits=lim)

# ---------- begin / finish ----------
expect("begin/finish marks and pins", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A,B) allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},   # rid not above mark
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 3},
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},  # already finished
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 3},   # mark is 3 -> reject
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 3},
], [OK, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 1}, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 1}, {"ok": True, "allow": False}, REJ, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "allow": False}])

expect("begin without active", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
], [OK, REJ])

# ---------- open / send / recv / close ----------
def wirehex(epoch, state, dest_label, stream, cgen):
    import struct
    return struct.pack('>4s5I', b'EMC4', epoch, state, dest_label, stream, cgen).hex()

expect("transport handoff and duplicates", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A,B) allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "B"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 6, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},  # different rid
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},  # different unit
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": wirehex(1, 1, 4, 1, 1)},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": wirehex(1, 1, 4, 1, 1).upper()},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": wirehex(1, 2, 4, 1, 1)},  # wrong bytes
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": "zz" + wirehex(1, 1, 4, 1, 1)[2:]},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": wirehex(1, 1, 4, 1, 1)[:46]},
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},  # after finish
], [OK, OK, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 1},
    OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 1, 4, 1, 1)},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 2},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 2},
    REJ, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 2},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 2},
    REJ, REJ, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "allow": True},
    REJ])

expect("send rules", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},  # no ctx
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [2, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},  # no conn
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "Z"},  # bad dest
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},  # stream mark
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 3, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "close", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 4, "destination": "B"},  # closed
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 3, "wire": None},  # packet gone
], [OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK, REJ, REJ, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 0, 4, 1, 1)}, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 0, 4, 3, 1)},
    OK, REJ, REJ])

# recv destination mismatch and wrong generation
expect("recv validation", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "B"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 3, 1], "service": "C"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 3, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},  # wrong service
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 2], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},  # wrong gen
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 2], "stream": 1, "wire": None},  # wrong conn gen
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 2, "wire": None},  # no packet
], [OK, OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 0, 4, 1, 1)},
    REJ, REJ, REJ, REJ])

# ---------- store / load / unlink ----------
expect("file handoff", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A,B) allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "B"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [9, 3]},
    {"op": "load", "file": [9, 3], "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "load", "file": [9, 4], "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 2},   # wrong gen
    {"op": "load", "file": [8, 3], "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 2},   # no inode
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [9, 5]},  # different gen
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [9, 3]},  # overwrite
    {"op": "unlink", "file": [9, 4]},                              # wrong gen
    {"op": "unlink", "file": [9, 3]},
    {"op": "load", "file": [9, 3], "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 2},   # unlinked
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [9, 3]},  # gen <= hw
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [9, 4]},  # ok
], [OK, OK, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 1},
    OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 2},
    REJ, REJ, REJ, OK, REJ, OK, REJ, REJ,
    OK])

# load advances by reader service
expect("load advances by reader", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A,B,C) allow;"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},    # state = START on A = 1
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "B"},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "load", "file": [1, 1], "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1},  # state 2
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 3, 1], "service": "C"},
    {"op": "load", "file": [1, 1], "unit": [0, 3, 1], "rid": 1},  # state DENY
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 3, 1], "rid": 1},
], [OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 1}, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 2}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": DENY},
    {"ok": True, "allow": False}])

# ---------- pinned epochs ----------
expect("contexts pin epochs", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 2, "policy": "match(A,A) allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 2},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},   # old epoch still allows
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},   # new epoch denies A (needs A,A)
], [OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 2, "state": 1},
    {"ok": True, "allow": True},
    {"ok": True, "allow": False}])

# ---------- capacity limits ----------
lim = dict(LIM); lim["images"] = 1
expect("image capacity", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 2, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
], [OK, REJ], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["units"] = 1
expect("unit capacity", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "A"},
], [OK, REJ], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["connections"] = 1
expect("connection capacity", [
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [2, 1]},
], [OK, REJ], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["packets"] = 1
expect("packet capacity atomic", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "A"},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 2, "destination": "A"},  # capacity
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 2, "destination": "A"},  # mark not raised
    {"op": "inspect"},
], [OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": None, "state": 0} if False else {"ok": True}, {"ok": True}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(0, 0, 10, 1, 1) if False else {"x": 1}} if False else {"ok": True, "wire": "skip"},
    REJ, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "active": None, "images": [], "units": 1, "contexts": 2,
     "connections": 1, "packets": 1, "files": 0}], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["files"] = 1
expect("file capacity", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "file": [2, 1]},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "file": [1, 1]},  # overwrite ok at capacity
], [OK, {"ok": True}, {"ok": True}, OK, REJ, OK], limits=lim)

# cell capacity: 3-service image all-allow has 3 cells... use limits cells=2
lim = dict(LIM); lim["cells"] = 2
expect("cell capacity", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
], [REJ], limits=lim)
lim = dict(LIM); lim["cells"] = 3
expect("cell capacity exact", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 2, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
], [OK, REJ], limits=lim)

# ---------- inspect ----------
expect("inspect empty", [{"op": "inspect"}],
       [{"ok": True, "active": None, "images": [], "units": 0, "contexts": 0,
         "connections": 0, "packets": 0, "files": 0}])

# refs counting with packets + files
expect("inspect refs", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "A"},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},
    {"op": "inspect"},
], [OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 0, 10, 1, 1)},
    OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0},
    {"ok": True, "active": 1, "images": [[1, 1, 3, 5]], "units": 1, "contexts": 2,
     "connections": 1, "packets": 1, "files": 0 if False else 1}])

# ---------- denied contexts ----------
expect("denied context can be sent", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A,B) allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "B"},   # START on B -> DENY
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "B"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1},
], [OK, OK, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": DENY}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, DENY, 4, 1, 1)},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": DENY},
    {"ok": True, "allow": False}])

summary()
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/test_lifecycle.py
